probes.question: Which group of consumers has been described as pivotal in the shift toward locally-made, handcrafted products?
probes.answer: Millennial consumers, whose preference for products with a story and a soul has been pivotal in the shift.
verbatim: The influence of millennial consumers, with their preference for products with a story and a soul, has been pivotal in this shift.

probes.question: By what percentage did exports from developing countries of arts and crafts goods reportedly increase, according to the International Trade Centre?
verbatim: there had been a 12% increase in exports from developing countries related to goods classified under the category of arts and crafts.

probes.question: Which tech entrepreneur addressed how digital tools are changing the game for craftspeople at a conference on September 30, 2023?
verbatim: In a conference on September 30, 2023, tech entrepreneur Emily Zhao addressed how digital tools are changing the game.

probes.question: What does the new initiative announced by the Minister of Economy on February 20, 2024 include?
probes.answer: Microfinancing, training workshops in digital literacy, and a national directory for local artisans to increase visibility.
verbatim: The program includes microfinancing, training workshops in digital literacy, and a national directory for local artisans to increase visibility.

probes.question: Why are forward-thinking businesses actively seeking collaborations with local artisans?
probes.answer: To create artisan-inspired product lines, which blur the lines between traditional craftsmanship and modern retail.
verbatim: Forward-thinking businesses are actively seeking collaborations with local artisans to create artisan-inspired product lines, thus blurring the lines between traditional craftsmanship and modern retail.
